description: This file is part of the 'spew' package, providing functions for deep pretty-printing of Go data structures, including handling of various types, constants, and reflection-based sorting.

methods.name: catchPanic
methods.description: Handles panics during method calls, writing panic info to the writer.

methods.name: handleMethods
methods.description: Attempts to call Error and String methods on a reflect.Value, handling panics.

methods.name: printBool
methods.description: Outputs a boolean as 'true' or 'false' to the writer.

methods.name: printInt
methods.description: Outputs an int64 value in specified base to the writer.

methods.name: printUint
methods.description: Outputs a uint64 value in specified base to the writer.

methods.name: printFloat
methods.description: Outputs a float64 value with specified precision.

methods.name: printComplex
methods.description: Outputs a complex128 value with real and imaginary parts.

methods.name: printHexPtr
methods.description: Outputs a uintptr as a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: sortValues
methods.description: Sorts a slice of reflect.Values considering various type-specific rules.
